name: Sigurd Curtis
source:
Likes: Creatures with wings, coffee
Dislikes: Inconsiderate people
Hobbies: Teasing Klaus
Skills: Riding a cloud bird

"I saw you in the darkness. You brought light to me."

Leslie: Sigurd is the only student who can equally discuss the matter with Klaus.
With his outstanding magic skill and intelligence, he is best known as Klaus' right-hand-man.
His major is taming and he is a skillful rider of a cloud bird.
He is good at dealing with my super talkative familiar, Chica.
I don't even know how he does it, I guess he has endless patience...
*Shrug*

[Official in-game description]
